## About
Brake & Wheel Center is owned by Monte Benedick, an ASE Certified Master automotive technician. Monte worked at shops like Precision Motive, Upper Grove Way Auto and Frank's Garage, then at Brake & Wheel Center itself, before he had the chance to buy the business and keep up its standard of work.
Cars are more complicated than they used to be, and a problem that was once simple can take more time and know-how to sort out. That is why we put communication first. You should understand exactly what needs to be done and the time it will involve before any work begins.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 40 Google reviews. One reviewer was sent our way by their body shop and has stayed ever since. Another doesn't live in the area and still makes the trip.

## Services
- Brake service and repairs: Brake service and repair work.
- Smog checks and failed smog repair: Smog checks, smog certification, and diagnosis and repair when a car fails.
- Brake and lamp certification: State brake and lamp certification for your car.
- Computerized wheel alignment: Wheel alignments done on computerized equipment.
- Suspension repairs: Shocks, struts and other suspension work.
- Check engine light testing: Testing to find out why your check engine light is on.
- Air conditioning service and repairs: Air conditioning service and repair to keep your car comfortable.
- Factory maintenance service: 30-60-90 factory maintenance service.
- Cooling system repairs: Repair work on your car's cooling system.
- Transmission service and repairs: Transmission service and repair work.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: My car failed its smog check. Can you help?
A: Yes. We test cars that failed smog and handle the repairs needed to get them passing.

Q: What if my car can't be driven to the shop?
A: Give us a call. We can help with towing.
